title: Majestic Blunder
reviewNotes: Three selected branches, 21 exact positions from the complete six-piece source root (Be5, not Bd5). Ba1 ...Kxa1 Kc2 allows ...b3+ Kxb3 and the promotion race ends in actual Qc2 mate. Kc1 ...b5 cxb6 en passant is actual stalemate. Bg7 ...a1=Q Bxa1 ...Kxa1 liquidates to a drawn pawn ending. Saved stable images resolve bishop/king placement and distinguish it from a dragging frame.
